resume_protocol: Fetch latest main SHA, PR exact head, diff, CI and this checkpoint before editing.
Treat only committed code and passing tests as completed; never infer completion from chat history.
If main moved, compare/reconcile explicitly; never force-reset or overwrite unverified work.
goal: Replace the equal-weight coordinate row's vertical dividers with restrained neutral-gray middle dots so it reads as one natural sentence-like coordinate: 校第 X 名 · 班第 X 名 · X 分.
requirements: Keep school rank, class rank and total score equal in font size, weight and color.
Use neutral-gray middle dots, not theme-green separators and not border-left rules.
Dots are purely punctuation: lower visual emphasis than the coordinate text.
Preserve exam name/date above the coordinate row.
Maintain flex-wrap behavior on narrow screens and avoid a separator appearing as the first visible token on a wrapped line.
Version exactly 0.4.5; final exact-head CI success before expected_head_sha merge; main CI + Cloudflare production attestation required.
